dialogues.jp: 今朝、環から電話があった。
dialogues.en:
Her voice was more enegertic than I thought it would be,
which filled me with a sense of relief.
dialogues.text:
Her voice was more enegertic than I thought it would be,
which filled me with a sense of relief.

dialogues.jp:
思っていたよりは元気そうな声で、とりあえず
はほっとした。
dialogues.en:
If something were to happen to her... I'd worry about it the
whole night, though of course I wouldn't tell her.
dialogues.text:
If something were to happen to her... I'd worry about it the
whole night, though of course I wouldn't tell her.

dialogues.jp:
万一環に何かあったら……なんて一晩中心配し
ていたなんてことは、勿論内緒にしておいた。
dialogues.en:
The brightness of her voice as compared to yesterday's call
was heartening.
dialogues.text:
The brightness of her voice as compared to yesterday's call
was heartening.

dialogues.jp:
昨日電話を取り次いでもらえなかったことが原
因の一端でもあるが、元気な声を聞けた以上、
そんなことはどうでも良かった
dialogues.en:
She tried to apologize so many times for "ruining Golden
Week" and "about the Miko Club".
dialogues.text:
She tried to apologize so many times for "ruining Golden
Week" and "about the Miko Club".

dialogues.jp:
環は、『ゴールデンウィークを台無しにしてし
まって……』とか、『巫女部の方々にも……』
なんて謝ってばかりだった。
dialogues.en:
I chose my words carefully to keep her from taking any more
burden, and told her to recover fully first.
dialogues.text:
I chose my words carefully to keep her from taking any more
burden, and told her to recover fully first.

dialogues.jp:
俺は極力、環が負担に思わないよう、言葉を選
んで、とにかくゆっくり休んで体調を回復させ
るようにだけ言った。
dialogues.en: I avoided the subject of all the quitting Miko Club members.
dialogues.text: I avoided the subject of all the quitting Miko Club members.

dialogues.jp:
巫女部の部員が辞めてしまったことには触れな
かった。
dialogues.en: She'd surely find out sooner or later.
dialogues.text: She'd surely find out sooner or later.

dialogues.jp: どうせ、いつかは知ることになる。
dialogues.en: There's no point in delaying her recovery any longer.
dialogues.text: There's no point in delaying her recovery any longer.

dialogues.jp: 体力が回復してからでも遅くは無い。
dialogues.en: I won't let her worry about small issues.
dialogues.text: I won't let her worry about small issues.

dialogues.jp: 今は、余計な心配をさせたくなかった。
dialogues.en:
She also mentioned that she felt bad about not being able to
go to the training camp with me...
dialogues.text:
She also mentioned that she felt bad about not being able to
go to the training camp with me...

dialogues.jp:
環は、俺と合宿に行きたかった……なんて残念
そうに言ってくれた。
dialogues.en: The feeling was mutual. We discussed about it a lot.
dialogues.text: The feeling was mutual. We discussed about it a lot.

dialogues.jp:
それは俺も同感だった。色々な話もしたかった
し。
dialogues.en: But it can be gone to any other time.
dialogues.text: But it can be gone to any other time.

dialogues.jp: でも、合宿はまたいつだって行ける。
dialogues.en: When Tamaki's happy again...
dialogues.text: When Tamaki's happy again...

dialogues.jp: 環が元気になったら……。
dialogues.en: That's why we promised, next year, to go again.
dialogues.text: That's why we promised, next year, to go again.

dialogues.jp:
だから、俺たちは、来年行くことを約束しあっ
た。
dialogues.en: Next year...
dialogues.text: Next year...

dialogues.jp: 来年……。
dialogues.en: I said that without thinking much.
dialogues.text: I said that without thinking much.

dialogues.jp: 自然と口から出ていた。
dialogues.en:
The next year, and the year after that... I'd be with her
always.
dialogues.text:
The next year, and the year after that... I'd be with her
always.

dialogues.jp: 来年も、再来年も、ずっと一緒にいたい。
dialogues.en: There's no basis, request or promise for that.
dialogues.text: There's no basis, request or promise for that.

dialogues.jp: 根拠のない、頼りない約束かもしれない。
dialogues.en: Just the belief in our future...
dialogues.text: Just the belief in our future...

dialogues.jp: でも今は、同じ未来を信じたいから……。
dialogues.en: ◆Tamaki's Call?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Tamaki's Call?◆

She apologized for not being able to go to the training

dialogues.text:
She apologized for not being able to go to the training

俺が来年行こうと言うと、本当に嬉しそうだっ

dialogues.en: I said we'd go next year instead, which made her happy.
dialogues.text: I said we'd go next year instead, which made her happy.
